IT Service Transition Consultant

Category: Infrastructure/Cloud
Main location: Canada, Quebec, Montréal
Position ID: J1126-1603
Employment Type: Full Time

Position Description:

We are seeking an experienced IT operations professional to prepare strategic initiatives for a smooth transition into production. You will help ensure that new and changed business services can be supported, monitored, and restored effectively from Day 1.

As the Operations Center representative, you will work with project teams, business stakeholders, support groups, and vendors from the early stages of each initiative. You will define support requirements, confirm operational readiness, and coordinate acceptance before go-live. You will also contribute to major incident response, problem management, change governance, and the development of internal Operations Center staff.

Your future duties and responsibilities:

- Service transition and readiness: Represent the Operations Center from design through post-launch hypercare. Define support models, service ownership, and escalation paths. Review transition deliverables against readiness criteria and coordinate operational acceptance.
- Monitoring and alerting: Work with business owners, support teams, and vendors to define monitoring requirements, including key metrics, thresholds, and dashboards that help identify issues before they affect business operations.
- Runbooks and procedures: Develop, test, and validate runbooks with stakeholders. Ensure they include diagnostic steps, recovery procedures, approved workarounds, and communication templates.
- Major incident support: Participate in high-impact incident response as needed. Support crisis teams and service restoration, and contribute to post-incident reviews and process improvements.
- Problem management and root cause analysis: Coordinate root cause investigations and the resolution of recurring incidents with technical teams and vendors. Manage problem records through to resolution.
- Change governance: Assess proposed production changes for operational impact and readiness. Present recommendations to the Change Advisory Board (CAB), ensure freeze periods are followed, and track changes related to corrective actions.
- Service documentation and coaching: Maintain service documentation, including RACI matrices, dependencies, and failure scenarios. Coach Operations Center agents, create operating procedures, and turn operational metrics such as MTTA, MTTR, and readiness gaps into improvement actions.
Required Qualifications
- At least five years of experience in IT operations, IT service management, service transition, or major incident management.
- Experience working in complex environments with multiple vendors and teams across different regions.
- Strong knowledge of the ITIL framework. ITIL 4 Foundation certification is preferred; an ITIL Specialist or Managing Professional certification is an asset.
- Demonstrated ability to establish governance, processes, and documentation, and to drive adoption across project and support teams.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently with minimal guidance.
- Excellent spoken and written English is required to work effectively with global teams and international vendors.

Required qualifications to be successful in this role:

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with SAP environments, including S/4HANA or ECC, integration layers, and IT service management tools such as ServiceNow.
- Foundational knowledge of IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, databases, and cloud platforms.
- Experience managing managed service providers (MSPs) and external vendors.
- Experience in consulting or in a manufacturing or industrial IT environment.
